turns.speaker: practitioner
turns.text: Hi there, can you hear me okay?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Yep, you're a little quiet, but it's fine.

turns.speaker: practitioner
turns.text: Let me turn the volume up. Is that better?

turns.speaker: practitioner
turns.text: Great. What's been on your mind about stress lately?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Work, mostly. I've been lying awake running through my to-do list.

turns.speaker: practitioner
turns.text: Your to-do list follows you to bed.

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Every night. I'd really like to be able to switch off.

turns.speaker: practitioner
turns.text: What has helped you switch off in the past?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Writing things down helped, back when I did it. I stopped when things got busy.

turns.speaker: practitioner
turns.text: Getting the list out of your head and onto paper gave your mind permission to rest.

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Huh, yeah. I could keep a notebook by the bed again.

turns.speaker: practitioner
turns.text: That's a thoughtful idea, and you came up with it yourself.
